repos_data.description: :rocket: Lightning fast and elegant mvc framework for Java8

LinkStack - the ultimate solution for creating a personalized & professional profile page. Showcase all your important links in one place, forget the limitation of one link on social media. Set up your personal site on your own server with just a few clicks.

Slate - a Laravel Blade UI Kit is a set of anonymous blade components built using TailwindCSS v4 with built-in dark mode support for your next Laravel and Livewire project. Perfect for Laravel UI development with beautiful, accessible components.
